target.statement: ONESHOT VUS-PR = 0.710 (gap closed ρ = 82.8%) on the univariate TSB-AD collection, averaged over 152 series

compute.basis: Method is a softmax weighting over precomputed released detector score vectors from TSB-AD; no detector is trained, so the work is downloading score archives, filtering near-constant vectors, and running a cheap per-series weighting + VUS-PR evaluation over 152 series.

blockers: Released score vectors for the full TSB-AD detector pool must be downloaded (large archives) and the exact 152-series eligibility filtering must be re-derived
Exact temperature τ and random-draw seeding protocol must be matched to hit 0.710 precisely; small deviations expected
title: OneShot: Label-Efficient Detector Weighting for Time Series Anomaly Detection
